gen-comfortaa-gf-manjari: Manjari is a sans with wide, unclosed terminals and a steady line weight. Manjari does the patient talking, while Comfortaa, with its ring-like c and stretched-out spacing, does the showing off up top.
gen-comfortaa-gf-mina: A c shaped like a wide-open ring and neon-tube strokes give Comfortaa its look, while Mina stays plain as stitched thread. What they share most is openness, curve after curve.
gen-comfortaa-gf-moderustic: Comfortaa draws every stroke like neon tubing, round and uniform. Comfortaa excels at the loud entrance, while Moderustic, a sans-serif with broad-nib curves left unfinished, does the quieter work of carrying text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans has letter openings as wide as a door left ajar, a plain sans through and through. Mona Sans would settle into page after page of text, while Comfortaa's contrast-free strokes keep the headline playful.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Friendly describes Comfortaa's single line weight and ring-shaped c, drawn like neon tube. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back to leave big gaps, so text flows lightly beneath.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Comfortaa's c looks like a wide-open ring, and its strokes keep the flat line of a stencil brush. Noto Sans Hatran adds a funnel-wide e, so the pairing stays friendly throughout.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Comfortaa draws up strokes and side strokes with no visible difference, like neon tubing bent into a ring-shaped c. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi stays unclogged; Comfortaa earns its keep big and short.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Noto Sans Kawi has an open-jawed c, like a pair of pliers. Text in it moves along smoothly, with Comfortaa's sign-painter's-stencil flatness of line weight supplying the headline's cheerful punch.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Noto Sans Linear B glides around each bend without obstruction. Shrink Comfortaa down and its flat, brush-free line loses its swagger, while blowing up the body would just exaggerate that smooth path.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Round, friendly, and cut from one gauge of tubing: that's Comfortaa. Comfortaa earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans NKo Unjoined, a sans-serif with wide openings on small letters, handles the rest.
